log_file.description: Path to the log file for the API server.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

debug.description: Enable debug-level logging (very verbose, for troubleshooting).

bind_host.description: IP address the API server will listen on (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or specific IP).

bind_port.description: TCP port for the Designate API server.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle incoming requests (adjust based on CPU cores).

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) before a request times out.

max_requests.description: Maximum requests per child worker before restart (0 = unlimited).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the API server.

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for validating client certificates (optional).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if SSL enabled).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if SSL enabled).

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name for the project (tenant).

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name for the user.

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone project name for the Designate service user.

keystone_username.description: Keystone username for the Designate service.

keystone_password.description: Password for the Designate Keystone user (set securely via config management or secrets manager in production).

keystone_service_name.description: Name of the Designate service in Keystone.

keystone_region_name.description: Keystone region where the Designate service is deployed.

enable_rate_limiting.description: Enable request rate limiting via oslo.middleware.

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) for request body (1 MiB default).

rate_limit_rules.description: List of rate-limiting rules to customize limits per path or method. Each rule is for documentation; actual rules typically defined in paste.ini or via middleware config.

name.description: Human-readable name or description of the rule.

notification_driver.description: Notification transport driver (e.g., messagingv2 for Oslo Messaging, or null for disabled).

messaging_transport_url.description: RabbitMQ (or other transport) connection string for notifications (used when driver=messagingv2).

pools.description: List of DNS zones/pools to serve. Each pool defines a target DNS backend (e.g., BIND9).

database_connection_recycle_time.description: Time (seconds) to recycle database connections (avoid stale connections).

database_max_overflow.description: Maximum number of additional DB connections beyond pool size.

database_max_pool_size.description: Base size of the database connection pool.

notification_transport_url.description: Alternative transport URL for notifications (overrides notification_driver + rabbit settings if non-empty).

cors_allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS (e.g., ['https://horizon.example.com']).

cors_expose_headers.description: List of response headers to expose to CORS clients.
